label: Be going to
outcome: Lo studente usa be going to per piani/intenzioni già decisi e previsioni basate su evidenza presente, con forma corretta di be, negative e domande.
do_not_teach_yet: Present Continuous arrangements as the main target

italian_learner_risks.risk: adding to before the main verb twice
choosing going to only because tomorrow appears
italian_learner_risks.target: read whether the idea is a prior plan or evidence-based prediction

context_bank: objects about to fall or break
quality_rejections: mixing fixed arrangements into the main lesson
evidence-free predictions treated as necessarily going to
